1.content: Found a potential cause in the login handler logic. Testing a fix now.
The fix has been deployed to staging. Awaiting QA verification.

2.content: Found the bottleneck in the database query. Proceeding to add indexing.
Performance has significantly improved after optimization. Waiting for code review.

3.content: The system is operating stably; no user issues reported yet.
Closing this ticket in 24 hours if no further reports are received.

4.content: Reproduced the issue on older iPhone models.
Adjusting Tailwind CSS breakpoints for better layout responsiveness.
UI fixes completed. The layout now renders correctly across all screen sizes.

5.content: Checking SMTP service logs to identify the root cause.
The issue was caused by an expired API key. Renewed and updated the configuration.
Sent a successful test email. Notification system is back online.
